payload.summary: Ledger correction: PR #3570 prlanded record names the wrong branch
payload.detail: docs/branch-review-records/a7be2760026da4bc040fa90bf847382bdcded2a8a7510ceaf7be4ac49c042211.record.md (added by PR #3609) records branch claude/reconcile-inbox-20261016 for PR #3570, but gh shows #3570's head branch was claude/reconcile-ledger-20261016 (merge fa526775c6, head d8eefbb91e). The SHAs and merge state are correct. Correct the branch name through the sanctioned branch-review-ledger tooling only; never hand-edit the record.
